version.local_snapshot: English Treebank frequency index, build algorithm 1

hash.scope: pinned source asset and all deployable derived artifacts

conditions: Ship NOTICE.md containing the complete BSD 3-Clause text and attribution.
Identify the lexical filtering, normalization, aggregation, and runtime tokenization performed by this project.

web_use.notes: The service loads a hash-pinned server-side lookup table and returns only document-level frequency, prevalence, and coverage aggregates. It provides no bulk vocabulary-list download.

transformations: Parse the published no-quote TSV, validate one [TOTAL] row, 613,309 source word rows, declared corpus totals, and all 15 category totals.
Normalize words with Unicode NFKC and str.lower(), retain bounded Unicode-alphabetic apostrophe/hyphen components, and reject normalized collisions.

At runtime, apply NFKC, normalize common typographic apostrophes to ASCII, lower-case, pre-segment sentences deterministically, and use NLTK 3.10.0 TreebankWordTokenizer rules audited as compatible with the upstream 3.8.1 lineage; then report only smoothed frequency/prevalence means and coverage.

status.reason: TUBELEX publishes the frequency list under BSD-3-Clause; the fixed source and deterministic derived artifact are hash-pinned, attributed, and separated from unavailable subtitle text.
